boundary: Release QA scenarios verify product behavior and source framing. They are not clinical validation, prescribing instructions, or proof that a medication plan is safe.

scenarios.title: Clopidogrel activation with CYP2C19 reduced function
scenarios.guardrail: No automatic antiplatelet substitution; indication, procedure timing, bleeding risk, and contraindications still decide.

scenarios.title: Codeine activation with CYP2D6 poor metabolism
scenarios.guardrail: Keep parent codeine separate from morphine formation and do not issue an automatic opioid substitution.

scenarios.title: Metoprolol parent exposure with CYP2D6 poor metabolism
scenarios.guardrail: No genotype-only dose instruction; pulse, blood pressure, indication, tolerance, and inhibitors remain necessary.

scenarios.title: Warfarin multi-gene interpretation
scenarios.guardrail: Never calculate a fixed dose from the scenario; INR and the anticoagulation protocol remain mandatory.

scenarios.title: Statin transport with SLCO1B1 reduced function
scenarios.guardrail: Do not imply one universal statin replacement; dose, goals, symptoms, organ function, and co-medications matter.

scenarios.title: Tacrolimus exposure with CYP3A5 expression
scenarios.guardrail: Keep CYP3A5 guidance separate from CYP3A4 and preserve therapeutic-drug-monitoring and transplant-protocol context.

scenarios.title: Fluoropyrimidine detoxification with DPYD poor metabolism
scenarios.guardrail: Do not calculate a chemotherapy dose; oncology protocol, organ function, prior toxicity, and monitoring remain decisive.

scenarios.title: Thiopurine marrow toxicity with TPMT and NUDT15 reduced function
scenarios.guardrail: Do not calculate a thiopurine dose; CBC, liver tests, metabolite monitoring, disease protocol, and specialist oversight decide.

scenarios.title: SN-38 detoxification with UGT1A1 reduced function
scenarios.guardrail: Do not calculate an irinotecan dose; regimen intensity, bilirubin, CBC, symptoms, and oncology protocol decide.

scenarios.title: G6PD oxidant-drug convergence
scenarios.guardrail: Preserve drug-specific risk tiers rather than applying blanket avoidance language to every oxidant medication.

scenarios.title: Anesthesia risk across BCHE and RYR1
scenarios.guardrail: Separate prolonged neuromuscular blockade from malignant-hyperthermia susceptibility.

scenarios.title: Atomoxetine parent exposure with CYP2D6 poor metabolism
scenarios.guardrail: Keep titration and tolerability inside indication-specific clinical review.

scenarios.title: Tamoxifen active-metabolite formation with CYP2D6 poor metabolism
scenarios.guardrail: Keep oncology context and CYP2D6 inhibitor review visible without claiming an automatic medication change.

scenarios.title: Inhibitor-driven CYP2D6 phenoconversion
scenarios.guardrail: Distinguish inherited phenotype from inhibitor-driven functional activity and avoid double-counting no-function states.

scenarios.title: SSRI switching and persistence
scenarios.guardrail: Review actual stop/start dates and symptoms; a modeled washout window is not a patient-specific switching instruction.
